hypothesis: Under fixed ten public scalar reads, replacing redundant anchor measurements at episode 3 with two previously unseen nonanchor observations will improve earliest detection and mismatches on unfamiliar swaps, provided anchor calibration from episodes 0 and 1 suffices.

controls.description: Public-only F5 rotating four-sensor control, common decoder checking episodes 3/5/7
Two nonanchor sensors at each episode 3/5/7, six distinct addresses, same common decoder

falsification: No improvement in early public detection or total mismatches, increased false alarms, illegal assignments, budget overruns or disjoint cohort identity violation constitutes a negative scientific result when prospective evidence exists.
caveat: Historical F3 engineering replay is not fresh science. The fixed geometry is intentionally pair-blind; it must not be retuned to already examined F4 sealed pair labels.
